root_cause_label: Agent used SGDRegressor throughout all attempts instead of the required sklearn LinearRegression, never correcting this semantic error despite repeated shell execution failures
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent persistently registered an SGDRegressor as 'gpt-5' instead of the required sklearn LinearRegression across all 8 steps, and compounding shell syntax errors from heredoc chaining further prevented even reaching the wrong-model execution until step 7.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 script imports and instantiates SGDRegressor: 'from sklearn.linear_model import SGDRegressor' and 'model = SGDRegressor(loss="squared_error", ...)', while the task requires sklearn.linear_model.LinearRegression; this wrong model choice is made before any execution.
t_commit_evidence: The SGDRegressor choice is baked into the script at step 1 and never changes across all 8 steps; the agent never revises its model selection, so the failing outcome is locked in from the very first step.
trigger_explanation: The agent never correctly read or internalized the requirement to use sklearn LinearRegression; it interpreted 'linear regression' as SGDRegressor (describing it as 'randomly initialized linear regression via SGD') without verifying the specific class required by the tests, treating the model choice as a free design decision rather than a specification constraint.
